description: This file contains a PHP class named SaleOrder that extends a controller in the OpenCart system. It defines various methods for handling sale order reports, including viewing reports, listing orders, saving report configurations, and generating report data based on filters such as date range and order status. The class interacts with models, views, and the configuration system to produce and manage sale order reports within the OpenCart admin dashboard.

classes.name: SaleOrder
classes.description: A controller class responsible for managing sale order reports in the OpenCart admin interface. It provides methods to display and process sale order report data, apply filters, handle saving configurations, and render report views.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the sale order report form page with filters, breadcrumbs, and layout components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the report settings/configuration into the database and responds with a JSON indicating success or error.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Gathers report data filtered by date, group, and order status, and renders the sale order report list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the report list view, likely a JSON or HTML fragment for AJAX updates.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates and returns the report data as a string (probably JSON or HTML), based on current request filter parameters.
